description: Returns the step-by-step build instructions for one costume idea: the decision summary (time and effort level), the materials list with buy-vs-own tags, numbered build steps, safety notes, and common parent questions with answers. Accepts a costume idea id or a costume name.

idea_id.description: Costume idea id from pick_costume (e.g. 'classic-ghost', 'ballerina'), or a costume name like 'ghost'.
